operations.description: This endpoint is responsible for fetching attendance data for the company employees. It is possible to paginate results, filter by period and/or specific employees. The result will contain a list of attendance periods, structured as defined here.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company attendances [PARAMS] date employees end limit offset start [SCHEMA] attendance periods response

operations.description: Provides a list of available time-off types, for example 'Paid vacation', 'Parental leave' or 'Home office'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company time off types [PARAMS] limit offset [SCHEMA] off resource time type

operations.description: This endpoint is responsible for fetching absence data for the company employees. It is possible to paginate results, filter by period and/or specific employees. The result will contain a list of absence periods, structured as defined here.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company time offs [PARAMS] date employees end limit offset start [SCHEMA] absence periods response
[METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company time offs [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] absence period response

operations.description: This endpoint is responsible for updating attendance data for the company employees. Attributes are not required and if not specified, the current value will be used. It is not possible to change the employee id.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME]  [PATH] company attendances [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] attendance period request response update

operations.description: This endpoint is responsible for adding attendance data for the company employees. It is possible to add attendances for one or many employees at the same time. The payload sent on the request should be a list of attendance periods, in the form of an array containing attendance period objects.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] company attendances [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] attendance new period request response

operations.description: Creates new employee. Status of the employee will be set to `active` if `hire_date` provided is in past. Otherwise status will be set to `onboarding`. This endpoint will respond with `id` of created employee in case of success.
This endpoint is responsible for adding absence data for the company employees.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] company time offs [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] create off period request response time
